notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet G7-SA123-5 (advance sign, 2400 x 1800 in the register): two boards in one assembly — the blue sign 2400 x 1200 (R150, blue edge 30 + white border 30, sheet 60 / 30) above the white slogan plate 2400 x 600 (R100, white edge 10 + blue border 20, sheet 30 / 10), drawn 50 apart as on the sheet (the gap is not dimensioned; measured), so the file is 2400 x 1850 with the gap transparent. Blue sign: rest area symbol S12 (tree and picnic table) at 260 %, 910 high, 145 from top and bottom — traced from the sheet's filled artwork; 1 km (numerals 200 E, unit 170 E lower case), ON and LEFT 200 E, white. Slogan plate: SURVIVE / THIS DRIVE 160 E blue. Legend placed from the sheet's filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (the sheet's chains were read for the series and heights): 1 200 E top 180 x 1479-1540; km 170 E top 210 x 1622-1919; ON 200 E top 500 x 1512-1887; LEFT 200 E top 820 x 1355-2043; SURVIVE 160 E blue top 1350 x 695-1701; THIS 160 E blue top 1590 x 545-1083; DRIVE 160 E blue top 1590 x 1174-1884. The sheet's lower blue plate with empty symbol boxes (supplementary services, where shown) is a template and is not drawn.
